svg.title: Strike Out What the Task Doesn't Need
svg.desc: A membership spreadsheet with the name, email, date of birth and health columns struck out and a non-identifying member key kept alongside club, month and type; before uploading, identify the data, check the rules and plan, and keep only what the task needs, because asking Claude to forget it or using incognito afterwards is not a control.
svg.text: Strike Out What the Task Doesn't Need
Decide before you upload; afterwards is too late.
